name: Acutus
description: Acutus is working to develop a novel electro-anatomical mapping catheter for atrial fibrillation ablation procedures. The Acutus system integrates ultrasound technology and a proprietary dipole density mapping technology to generate a three dimensional image of the left atrium over which the electric activity of the chamber can be precisely displayed in real time.

name: ADARx Pharmaceuticals
description: ADARx is developing a proprietary RNA targeting platform, including oligonucleotides for inhibition, degradation, and editing, together with novel oligonucleotide delivery technologies. ADARx has a growing pipeline of RNA targeting therapeutics for treating diseases across a range of therapeutic areas including genetic, cardiometabolic, and central nervous system diseases.

name: Adcendo
description: Adcendo is a clinical stage company developing first-in-class ADCs for the treatment of cancers. Lead program (ADCE-T02) targets tissue factor with an antibody designed for minimized interference with the coagulation pathway, reducing the risk of bleeding. ADCE-T02 uses a clinically validated linker-payload platform designed for improved bystander activity and linker stability.

name: Adela
description: Adela is focused on the detection of cancer and other high-morbidity, high-mortality conditions through a routine blood test. The company’s genome-wide methylation analysis technology has the unique ability to distinguish the most-highly informative (methylated) regions of the genome from non-informative regions and preferentially target those informative regions for sequencing.

name: Adicet Bio
description: Adicet Bio, Inc., is developing a novel universal immune-cell therapy platform for cancer and other disease indications and novel immunotherapies directed to disease-specific targets derived from the intracellular proteome.

name: Advanced Enzymes
description: Advanced Enzymes is a leading enzyme company in India with a portfolio of over 400 unique enzyme products.

name: Aer Therapeutics
description: Aer Therapeutics is developing a novel inhaled approach to treat lung diseases characterized by excess mucus and mucus plugs.

name: Aerin Medical
description: Aerin Medical is developing non-invasive procedures for the treatment of chronic nasal airway conditions. The company’s FDA-cleared products, the VivAer® Stylus for nasal airway obstruction and the RhinAer® Stylus for chronic rhinitis, leverage Aerin’s proprietary temperature-controlled technology, which allows ENT physicians to reliably improve patients’ symptoms with a nonsurgical procedure under local anesthetic in their offices.

name: AirNexis Therapeutics
description: AirNexis Therapeutics is developing a dual PDE3/4 inhibitor for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

name: AirStrip
description: A leader in clinical surveillance, decision support, and alarm management solutions. AirStrip delivers actionable, data-driven insights that help clinicians improve patient outcomes and operational efficiency.

name: AK Medical
description: AK Medical is the leader in joint replacement products and solutions in China. The company has a wide range of orthopedic products, covering over 2,000 hospitals through more than 500 distributors. AK medical is also the pioneer of applying 3D printing technology in orthopedics products.

name: Alentis Therapeutics
description: Alentis is a clinical stage biotech company developing first-in-class ADCs and antibodies targeting Claudin-1 for the treatment of solid tumors and fibrosis.

name: Alpheus Medical
description: Alpheus™ Medical, Inc., is developing a novel sonodynamic therapy (SDT) platform targeting solid body cancers. The company's lead product utilizes a novel, non-invasive drug-device combination for outpatient treatment of recurrent glioblastoma multiforme (rGBM).

name: Alterome Therapeutics
description: Alterome Therapeutics is a precision oncology biotech developing alteration-specific therapeutics to address high value and validated oncogenic drivers. The company is led by seasoned R&D leaders with a history of developing marketed oncology small molecule drugs.

name: Altis Labs
description: Altis Labs is developing a novel endpoint for oncology trials to improve the predictive power of early studies to determine a drug’s efficacy.

name: Alumis
description: Biopharma company focused on providing patients life-changing new treatment options by identifying, acquiring, and accelerating development and commercialization of promising drug candidates. With an initial focus on immunology, Alumis is targeting both early-stage innovation as well as clinical-stage programs where it can leverage its expertise to rapidly advance medicines to patients.

name: AnchorDx
description: AnchorDx is a leading liquid biopsy company to develop cancer early detection products and to provide clinical laboratory testing services. The company has developed a broad pipeline of products in cancer early detection and recurrence monitoring, which focuses on multiple major cancer types using blood and urine-based NGS and qPCR assays.

name: Angitia Biopharmaceuticals
description: A Chinese biotechnology company focusing on the discovery and development of innovative therapeutics for serious musculoskeletal diseases globally.

name: ArCHitect Therapeutics
description: ArCHitect Therapeutics is developing oral therapies by targeting disease drivers that have been difficult-to-drug with existing chemistry. Its approach transforms dormant carbon-hydrogen (C-H) bonds – the most common bonds in small molecules – into powerful building blocks of novel drug architectures.

name: ArriVent
description: ArriVent is a clinical-stage drug development platform company focusing on identifying, licensing and unlocking the global value of top biotech innovations from China into the U.S. The company has in-licensed multiple assets of various modalities including small molecules, large molecules, ADCs, etc.

name: ARS Pharmaceuticals
description: ARS is developing treatments for patients and parents affected by severe allergic reactions that are safe and effective, needle-free, easy to carry, and simple to administer.

name: Aspen Neuroscience
description: Aspen Neuroscience is focused on developing induced pluripotent stem cells to treat neurological conditions.

name: Aura Biosciences
description: Aura Biosciences is a clinical-stage company developing laser-activated, virus-like drug conjugates for high-unmet-need cancers, including ocular cancers.

name: Avalo Therapeutics
description: Avalo is a clinical stage biotechnology company focused on the treatment of immune dysregulation. Avalo’s lead asset is AVTX-009, an anti-IL-1β mAb, targeting inflammatory diseases

name: Avenzo Therapeutics
description: Developing the next generation of oncology therapies for patients

name: Averna Therapeutics
description: Developing mRNA-encoded genomic medicines that can be delivered in lipid nanoparticles to durably and safely treat a broad range of diseases in a redosable format

name: Aviceda
description: Aviceda is a clinical-stage company harnessing immune cells’ natural checkpoints for the treatment of diseases characterized by chronic, non-resolving inflammation. Its lead asset is an intravitreal, synthesized sialic acid-coated nanoparticle in Phase 2b/3 development for geographic atrophy

name: Avitide
description: Avitide develops customized biopharmaceutical affinity purification products. The Avitide platform reduces bioprocess development timelines, program risk, and cost of manufacture by providing turnkey, cost-effective, highly specific affinity purification solutions. Industry-leading affinity resin discovery timelines integrate seamlessly into process development cycles, providing improved line-ofsight, platform operations and equipment, and predictable scalability.

name: Azura Opthalmics
description: Azura Ophthalmics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel. Azura Ophthalmics is developing an innovative portfolio of compounds – in combination with a novel drug delivery platform – to advance treatments for lid margin diseases such as Meibomian gland dysfunction (MGD), the leading cause of dry eye disease.

name: Baili
description: A leading china specialty pharma for developing innovative biologics for treating cancers

name: Beijing Star Sports Medicine
description: Star Sport Medicine is the leader in sports medicine in China, which provides surgical products and clinical solutions in sports medicine, including active surgical equipment and consumables in areas of knee, shoulder, ankle, elbow, hip and small joints

name: Belenos Biosciences
description: Belenos is advancing a differentiated pipeline of long-acting bispecific antibodies for the treatment of chronic inflammatory diseases. The lead asset, BEL512, targets TSLP and IL13, and is currently in multiple phase 2 studies in China and the US.

name: Binx Health
description: binx io is a first-of-its-kind, highly sensitive and specific, point-of-care (POC) diagnostic testing platform and is a rapid, qualitative, fully-automated test, designed to be easy to use, and intended for use in POC or clinical laboratory settings, providing the world’s first sample-to-answer result in about 30 minutes for the detection of chlamydia (CT) and gonorrhea (NG)– the two most tested-for STIs globally.

name: BioAge Labs
description: Clinical stage company developing an oral, brain-penetrant NLRP3 inhibitor for cardiovascular risk factors and DME, as well as an APJR agonist for metabolic conditions

name: Biobeat
description: Commercializing the first FDA-cleared, 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring system that is a patch-worn, cuff-less solution for diagnosis and treatment of hypertension

name: BiomX
description: BiomX is a clinical-stage microbiome company developing both natural and engineered phage cocktails designed to target and destroy bacteria that affect the appearance of skin, as well as harmful bacteria in chronic diseases, such as IBD, PSC, and cancer. BiomX discovers and validates proprietary bacterial targets and customizes phage compositions against these targets.

name: BlossomHill Therapeutics
description: BlossomHill Therapeutics is a small molecule drug discovery and development company focused on unmet medical needs in oncology and autoimmune disorders. The company is founded by renowned drug design and development scientist, J. Jean Cui, Ph.D. and biotech veteran, Y. Peter Li, Ph.D., M.B.A.

name: BMTfemme (fka MobileODT)
description: BMTfemme is commercializing an AI-powered portable colposcope, enabling primary care providers to perform specialist-level visual diagnosis of gynecological conditions.

name: Bonovo Orthopedics
description: Bonovo is a leading provider of orthopedic products to the Chinese healthcare market. Bonovo has over 15 years of experience manufacturing and distributing orthopedic products throughout China. Bonovo's unique relationships with leading clinicians and hospitals makes Bonovo an ideal partner for access to the Chinese orthopedic market.

name: Braveheart Bio
description: Braveheart Bio is a late-stage clinical company developing a cardiac myosin inhibitor in cardiovascular disease with potential best-in-class properties.

name: Brenig Therapeutics
description: Brenig Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing a selective, brain-penetrant small-molecule inhibitor of LRRK2, a key protein implicated in the pathogenesis of Parkinson’s disease, and a best-in-class, selective, brain-penetrant small-molecule inhibitor of NLRP3 designed to deliver effective brain-specific NLRP3 inhibition while minimizing on- and off-target effects.

name: Candid Therapeutics
description: Candid Therapeutics is an innovative biotechnology company dedicated to advancing T cell engagers for the treatment of immunological diseases. Established in 2024 and headquartered in San Diego, CA, Candid is driven by a team of repeatedly successful entrepreneurs with deep expertise and strong execution abilities. Supported by a distinguished syndicate of leading healthcare investors, Candid is committed to discovering and developing cutting-edge therapeutic programs that address significant unmet medical needs in immunology.

name: Carrot Fertility
description: Carrot Fertility is a global fertility benefits provider for employers, built to support employees as they navigate the fertility journey by offering financial benefit and high-touch support. Companies use Carrot to customize a fertility benefit that provides employees financial, medical, and emotional support as they pursue parenthood.

name: Cellipont Bioservices
description: Cellipont Bioservices is a privately held cell therapy CDMO operating in The Woodlands, TX with more than 15 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of cell therapies, ranging from small to large-scale batches. Cellipont has deep technical expertise and has been recognized by customers and partners for its ability to productively grow challenging cell types.

name: CHARM Therapeutics
description: CHARM Therapeutics is applying its end-to-end 3D deep learning protein-ligand co-folding technology, DragonFold, to develop small molecule therapeutics against previously hard-to-drug targets in cancer and other therapeutic areas.

name: Chemomab
description: Chemomab is developing novel chemokine blocking therapies for inflammatory and fibrotic disorders.

name: Compass Therapeutics
description: Compass Therapeutics is seeking to cure various cancer types through combination therapy by comprehensively drugging the tumor-immune synapse with human antibodies against over 50 cell surface and soluble targets.

name: Congruence Therapeutics
description: Congruence Therapeutics is a biotechnology company working at the interface of computational and experimental drug discovery to design novel small molecules for diseases of protein misfolding. Using structural bioinformatics, computational chemistry, and machine learning, the Company is deploying an in-silico platform that enables the design of new pharmacological stabilizers, a validated class of small molecules, at an unprecedented speed and scale.

name: Convergent Therapeutics
description: Clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing next-generation radiopharmaceutical therapies for prostate cancer

name: Corteria Pharmaceuticals
description: Corteria is a Sanofi spin out developing long acting corticotrophin release factor type 2 receptor (CRF2) agonists to overcome the limitations of short half-life urocortin analogs for use in heart failure.

name: Corvus Pharmaceuticals
description: Corvus Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of novel, first-in-class agents that target the immune system to treat patients with cancer. Using both small molecule and monoclonal antibody approaches, Corvus brings together scientists who played key roles in the development of Rituxan, Imbruvica, and Zelboraf to advance new immuno-oncology therapeutics.

name: Createrna, Inc.
description: Createrna, Inc is an innovative biopharmaceutical company with a special focus on immunology, respiratory, and cardiovascular diseases

name: Crinetics Pharmaceuticals
description: Crinetics Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focusing on treatments for rare endocrine disorders and endocrine-related cancers. The company is currently conducting a Phase 3 trial with its oral somatostatin agonist, Paltusotine, for the treatment of acromegaly, an orphan disease affecting more than 24,000 people in the United States. The company is also developing other oral somatostatin agonists for neuroendocrine tumors, hyperinsulinism, and chronic pain, as well as an oral small molecule for Cushing’s disease.

name: Curevo Vaccine
description: Curevo is a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to reducing the burden of infectious disease by developing vaccines with improved tolerability and accessibility. Curevo’s lead product is amezosvatein, an adjuvanted sub-unit vaccine to prevent shingles.

name: Cyrus Biotechnology
description: Cyrus Biotechnology is a privately-held biotechnology software company offering protein modeling and design capabilities to the biopharmaceutical, chemical, consumer products and synthetic biology industries. The company was founded in 2014 as a spin-out from the University of Washington, and offers Cyrus Bench®, a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform for protein structure prediction, modeling, stabilization, engineering and design to accelerate discovery of biologics and small molecules.

name: Dami & Xiaomi
description: Dami & Xiaomi is a healthcare services provider for children suffering from Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) or other developmental disabilities. Services such as ABA, speech therapy, and others are delivered to the patients through treatment centers

name: Dehan Dental
description: Dehan Dental is a leading dental chain in China, with Wuhan as its headquarters, covering several surrounding provinces, providing international orthodontics, dental implants and other key dental services.

name: Delfi Diagnostics
description: Delfi Diagnostics is developing a new class of high performance, affordable liquid biopsy tests for early cancer detection. Leveraging recent advances in cancer biology and machine learning, Delfi’s technology can achieve high performance from low-cost, widely available sequencing technology.

name: DIH
description: Focusing on improving functions & performance and enhancing medication safety & efficacy, DIH aspires to be a premier technology & application platform leader in Rehab & Sports Medicine (RSM) and Intelligent Medication & Supply (IMS) businesses, enabled by passionate teams working around the globe.

name: Disc Medicine
description: Disc Medicine is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing treatments for hematologic disorders. Disc Medicine is building a unique portfolio of innovative, first-in-class therapeutic candidates based on fundamental pathways of red blood cell biology.

name: DLAB
description: Leading Chinese company in general laboratory devices & instruments with R&D, manufacturing, and sales & marketing capabilities.

name: EC Healthcare
description: EC Healthcare is Hong Kong's largest non-hospital medical service provider focusing on preventive and precision medicine to build the leading one-stop healthcare ECOSYSTEM with a mission to bring Health, Beauty, and Happiness to more People. The Group provides a full range of services and products under its well-known brands, including those of its one-stop aesthetic medical solutions provider DR REBORN, which has ranked first in Hong Kong by sales for years and other diversified and multi-dimensional medical services.

name: Eddingpharm
description: Eddingpharm is a leading pharmaceuticals marketing company in the fast growing China market. It focuses on in-licensing, marketing and distributing hospital pharmaceutical products.\r\n\r\n With over 20 offices and 400 professional sales representatives, Eddingpharm is a partner of choice for many multi-national pharmaceutical companies.

name: Edgewise Therapeutics
description: Edgewise Therapeutics builds on our extensive experience in drug development and skeletal muscle research. Edgewise has built a custom discovery workshop for the discovery and optimization of novel therapeutics for a broad set of indications where skeletal muscle function is compromised.

name: Eilean Therapeutics
description: Eilean Therapeutics is a small molecule oncology drug discovery company committed to developing first in class and best in class therapeutics for hematologic malignancies.

name: Electra Therapeutics
description: Electra Therapeutics is a clinical stage biotechnology company developing therapies that target signal regulatory proteins (SIRP) for the treatment of immunological diseases and cancer. Electra currently has one program in clinical development and two additional preclinical programs. The company’s lead product candidate, ELA026, is a monoclonal antibody that targets SIRP on the cell surface of myeloid and T cells and depletes pathological immune cells.

name: Emergent BioSolutions Inc.
description: Emergent delivers protective and life-saving solutions for health threats like smallpox, mpox, botulism, Ebola, anthrax and opioid overdose emergencies.

name: EnLiven Therapeutics
description: EnLiven Therapeutics is a targeted oncology company developing small molecule kinase inhibitors. Enliven’s approach combines clinically validated biological targets and industry-leading chemistry to design best-in-class and first-in class therapies to address unmet needs in cancer.

name: Entero Healthcare
description: Entero is one of the largest pharmaceutical and medical device distribution companies in India. It has an extensive customer base of retail pharmacies and hospitals. Entero distributes products for most of the leading companies in the country through its pan-India network of state-of-the-art warehouses and technology infrastructure.

name: Enyo Pharma
description: ENYO Pharma is a clinical stage biotech with a unique drug discovery engine inspired by viruses. The company is currently entering Phase 2 with its lead compound Vonafexor in Alport Syndrome.

name: Epigenic Therapeutics
description: Epigenic Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to developing next generation gene editing therapy utilizing regulation of epigenetic genome for a variety of diseases. Founded in 2021 by leading scientists focused on discovering gene editing technologies and developing gene editing therapies, the company has multiple product candidates in the pipeline, including treatment for viral, cardiometabolic, ophthalmology and neurodegenerative diseases.

name: Ethris
description: Ethris is paving a new path from genes to therapeutic proteins using its proprietary messenger RNA technology platform, which enables the discovery, design and development of transcript therapies that drive the production of therapeutic proteins within patients’ cells and tissues. The company’s lead program ETH42 is in preclinical development for treatment of a rare pulmonary disease, primary ciliary dyskinesia.

name: Evox Therapeutics
description: Evox Therapeutics is a biotechnology company focused on improving the natural delivery capabilities of exosomes. Evox has developed a proprietary technology platform, DeliverEX, to enable it to modify exosomes, to load drugs into exosomes, and to target the delivery of these exosomes to organs of interest.

name: Evozyne
description: Evozyne creates novel protein systems that enable a healthier world.

name: Fore Bio
description: A personalized medicine diagnostics company assessing the activity of mutations and combination of mutations and their response to targeted drugs

name: ForSight VISION6
description: Forsight Vision 6 is developing an Accommodating Interocular Lens (AIOL) which aims to enable pristine vision across all distances post cataract surgery. The approach is differentiated, placing the lens over rather than in the capsular bag, thereby avoiding the stiffening which hinders accommodation. Founders and leadership are composed of world class ophthalmology veterans.

name: Forte Biosciences
description: Forte Biosciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company that is advancing FB102, which is a proprietary anti-CD122 monoclonal antibody therapeutic candidate for potentially broad autoimmune and autoimmune-related indications.

name: Forward
description: Forward Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of chronic inflammatory disorders.

name: Frido
description: Frido is a consumer medical company offering mobility assist devices like wheelchairs for patients with limited mobility and orthopedic body supports for pain relief and comfort enhancement. Frido follows an online-first marketing approach and sells its products across its own D2C website, online marketplaces, and offline channels.

name: Frontera Therapeutics
description: Leading gene therapy player developing high quality but affordably priced rAAV based therapeutics for the China market. The company currently has three programs in clinical trials, including FT-001 for LCA2, FT-002 for XLRP, and FT-003 for wet AMD and DME. It also has multiple preclinical programs for metabolic, cardiovascular, and CNS indications.

name: FUSmobile
description: FUSmobile is developing a handheld focused ultrasound device, addressing pain non-invasively, with initial focus on back pain.

name: Futurx
description: At FutuRx, Johnson & Johnson Innovation - JJDC, Takeda Ventures Inc. and OrbiMed Israel Partners teamed with the Office of the Chief Scientist of the Ministry of Economy in a national initiative to transform breakthrough discoveries into novel medicines. FutuRx envisions its role as a catalyst for drug development by bridging the gap between concept and proof-of-concept through its dedicated system and unique structure

name: GAUSH Medical
description: Gaush Medical is one of the largest ophthalmic device companies in China with both distribution and proprietary product business.

name: Gennao Bio
description: Gennao Bio is a genetic medicines company developing first-in-class targeted nucleic acid therapeutics utilizing a proprietary gene monoclonal antibody (GMAB) platform technology. GMAB is an adaptive technology that uses a novel, cell-penetrating antibody to non-covalently bind to and deliver therapeutic levels of a wide variety of nucleic acid payloads to select cells. This non-viral delivery platform is differentiated from traditional gene delivery systems as it can deliver multiple types of nucleic acids, allows for repeat dosing and employs well-established manufacturing processes. Gennao Bio is developing this delivery system with an initial focus on addressing significant unmet needs in oncology and rare monogenic skeletal muscle diseases.

name: Genocury Biotech
description: A Chinese biotech company developing in vivo CAR-T therapies for oncology and autoimmune diseases

name: GentiBio
description: GentiBio is a biotherapeutics company developing engineered regulatory T cells (EngTregs) programmed to treat autoimmune, alloimmune, autoinflammatory and allergic diseases. GentiBio’s proprietary autologous and allogeneic EngTregs platform integrates key complimentary technologies needed to successfully restore immune tolerance and overcome major limitations in existing regulatory T-cell therapeutics.

name: Good Doctor Cloud Health
description: Leading connected clinical services provider for primary care clinics in China with a cloud-based platform supporting the delivery of nurse practitioner and specialized treatment services, clinical lab testing services, telemedicine, and other online services

name: Harvest Integrated Research Organization (HiRO)
description: Market-leading, integrated, full service global clinical CRO with APAC & US centric operations and differentiating specialties in clinical development and data analytics.

name: Helicore Biopharma
description: Helicore Biopharma, Inc., is a clinical-stage multi-product biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of novel weight-loss therapeutics. Helicore’s proprietary platform leverages monoclonal antibodies that bind circulating GIP ligand, designed to improve the efficacy, dosing, and tolerability of anti-obesity therapies.

name: Iambic Therapeutics
description: The Iambic platform has been demonstrated to deliver high-quality, differentiated therapeutics to clinic with unprecedented speed and across multiple target classes and mechanisms of action. The Iambic team is advancing an internal pipeline of clinical assets to address urgent unmet patient needs.

name: iECURE
description: A mutation-agnostic in vivo gene editing company striving to cure devastating diseases with high unmet need. iECURE’s approach focuses on the in vivo insertion of healthy copies of disease-causing genes, with an initial focus in liver disorders.

name: Ikena Oncology
description: Ikena Oncology is a clinical-stage biotechnology company that discovers and develops patient-directed, biomarker-driven therapies for cancer patients.

name: Innvolution Healthcare Private Limited
description: Innvolution focuses on interventional cardiology with a comprehensive portfolio of products including imaging equipment and consumables. It is the largest indigenous manufacturer and supplier of Catheterization Laboratories (Cath Labs) in India. The company has a strong pan-India distribution network with multiple touchpoints across hospitals and interventional cardiologists.

name: Insilico Medicine
description: Insilico Medicine is developing next-generation artificial intelligence to cost down, accelerate, and increase the success rates in drug discovery and development. The company is constantly making breakthroughs in early stage R&D, launching software products, and advancing its own internal pipeline of small molecule therapeutics.

name: Insmed Incorporated
description: Insmed Incorporated is a commercial-stage global biopharmaceutical company striving to deliver first- and best-in-class therapies to transform the lives of patients facing serious diseases. The Company commercializes two approved therapies to treat chronic, debilitating lung diseases – ARIKAYCE® (amikacin liposome inhalation suspension) for the treatment of refractory MAC lung disease, and BRINSUPRI® (brensocatib) for the treatment of non-cystic fibrosis bronchiectasis. Insmed is also advancing a diverse portfolio of mid- to late-stage investigational medicines organized around three therapeutic areas: Respiratory, Immunology & Inflammation, and Neuro & Other Rare. The Company’s research engine is advancing a wide range of technologies and modalities, including gene therapy, AI-driven protein engineering, RNA end-joining, and synthetic rescue, in the pursuit of future pipeline candidates.

name: InspireMD
description: InspireMD is a commercial-stage medical device company developing novel carotid stent technologies with integrated embolic prevention systems (EPS) to deliver neurovascular protection and stroke prevention.

name: InventisBio
description: InventisBio is dedicated to deliver best- and first-in-class drug for cancer and metabolic disease to address large unmet medical need

name: Iswarya Fertility
description: Iswarya Fertility is one of India’s leading fertility chains offering a comprehensive suite of assisted reproductive treatments (ART), including IVF, IUI, embryo freezing, donor programs, surgical fertility procedures, and related fertility services.

name: Janux Therapeutics
description: Janux Therapeutics is developing novel immunotherapies with the company’s proprietary TRACTr technology. Janux’s TRACTr technology employs a modular design to rapidly engineer drug candidates against specific targets and can be applied to immunotherapies that target all three stages of an anti-tumor immune response.

name: Jinxin Fuxing Eldercare
description: Jinxin Fuxing Eldercare is one of the largest eldercare services companies in China. The company’s “three-in-one” care model focuses on the combination of high-quality clinical and regular eldercare services across facilities, community, and home care settings.

name: Kapiva
description: Kapiva is a leading health and wellness-focused consumer company marketing natural and Ayurveda products to the 20-45-year age group. The Company offers products for men’s health, skin and hair, weight management, lifestyle diseases, and daily wellness. Kapiva has an omnichannel distribution with a digital-first approach and is emerging as a leader amongst the direct-to-consumer natural and Ayurveda companies in India.

name: Kartos Therapeutics
description: Kartos Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a potentially best-in-class MDM2 inhibitor.

name: Keros Therapeutics
description: Keros is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development and commercialization of novel treatments for patients suffering from hematologic and musculoskeletal disorders with high unmet medical need. Keros is a leader in understanding the role of the transforming growth factor-beta, or TGF-beta, family of proteins, which are master regulators of red blood cell and platelet production as well as of the growth, repair and maintenance of muscle and bone.

name: Kumquat Biosciences
description: Kumquat’s mission is to develop innovative therapies to bring about sustainable and life-changing benefits to cancer patients.

name: Laekna Therapeutics
description: Laekna Therapeutics is a biotech company dedicated to the discovery and development of novel therapeutics for oncology and metabolic diseases

name: Lattice MedTech Private Limited
description: Lattice MedTech is a OrbiMed incubated healthcare platform providing end-to-end distribution, market access and expansion solutions in medical device segment. Lattice MedTech offers solutions across medical consumables, implants, and capital equipment, driving local distribution and full-service market expansion.

name: Laxmi Dental
description: Laxmi Dental is a leading dental products and lab services company offering crowns, bridges, aligners, and pediatric products for domestic and export markets. The Company has a global reach and caters to a large network of dentists in India, the USA, and Europe.

name: Leal Therapeutics
description: Developing novel therapeutics for patients with major disorders of the central nervous system

name: Lexeo Therapeutics
description: Lexeo is a clinical-stage genetic medicine company dedicated to reshaping heart health by applying pioneering science to fundamentally change how cardiovascular diseases are treated.

name: LifeCell
description: LifeCell is an established and trusted consumer healthcare services brand focused on maternal and child health. The Company operates India’s largest cord blood bank and is an emerging leader in the fast-growing reproductive diagnostics segment. The Company also offers placental tissue-based products that support the healing of chronic wounds.

name: Lomond Therapeutics
description: Lomond Therapeutics is a small molecule oncology drug discovery company committed to defeating and curing cancer.

name: Lupeng Pharmaceutical
description: Lupeng Pharmaceutical is a clinical-stage company dedicated to the discovery and development of innovative medicines for the treatment of hematological malignancies and autoimmune diseases, mainly focusing on covalent and non-covalent BTK, Bcl-2 and Bcl-xL inhibitors.

name: Magenta Medical
description: Medical device company developing self-expanding percutaneous mechanical circulatory support pumps intended to provide minimally-invasive support to the native heart during acute episodes of dysfunction.

name: Marksans Pharma
description: Marksans Pharma Limited is engaged in manufacturing, research and marketing of generic pharmaceutical formulations globally. Key focus areas are OTC and prescription (Rx) drugs across various therapeutic categories such as Pain Management, Cough & Cold, Cardiovascular & Central Nervous System, Anti-Diabetic, Gastrointestinal, and Anti-Allergic.

name: MBX Biosciences
description: MBX Biosciences is a biotechnology company creating therapies for rare endocrine diseases. MBX is strengthened by world-class proprietary peptide drug discovery capabilities.

name: MDClone
description: MDClone was founded to address one of the most critical bottle necks in the healthcare market by creating synthetic medical records, based on real data with interactive anonymization. Allowing for greater utilization of existing medical data in a manner that does not infringe on patients' privacy

name: MDxHealth SA
description: Mdxhealth is a commercial-stage precision diagnostics company that provides actionable molecular information to personalize patient diagnosis and treatment. The Company’s tests are based on proprietary genomic, epigenetic (methylation) and other molecular technologies and assist physicians with the diagnosis and prognosis of urologic cancers and other urologic diseases.

name: MedPharm
description: MedPharm is an end-to-end contract service provider of topical and transepithelial products supporting early-phase research, formulation development and in vitro testing services in addition to both clinical and commercial manufacturing.

name: Memebox
description: Memebox has a diverse portfolio of clean beauty and hypoallergenic brands including I Dew Care, Kaja, Nooni, Pony Effect, I'm Meme.

name: Mendra
description: Mendra is a biopharmaceutical company focused on improving the development and commercialization of rare disease therapies worldwide and utilizing AI to address long-standing challenges in patient identification, data curation, and clinical development for rare diseases.

name: Minghui Pharmaceutical
description: Close-to-commercial biotech company developing best-in-class treatments for oncology, autoimmune and immunological diseases. Global leader in the development of ADC + next-generation I/O combination.

name: MinvervaX
description: MinervaX is pursuing the development of a maternal vaccine for the prevention of adverse pregnancy outcomes and life-threating infections caused by Group B streptococcus (GBS). The vaccine is based on adjuvanted proteins antigens covering close to 100% of clinical GBS isolates.

name: Mirador Therapeutics
description: Mirador Therapeutics envisions a bold new era of precision medicine for immune-mediated inflammatory and fibrotic diseases driven by speed and better development accuracy.

name: Mondego Bio
description: Mondego Bio is developing best-in-class Protein tyrosine phosphatase non-receptor type 2 (PTPN2) inhibitors, providing a potential immuno-oncological therapy with an improved safety and tolerability profile.

name: Myriad Genetics
description: A leading molecular diagnostic testing and precision medicine company dedicated to advancing health and well-being for all. Myriad Genetics develops and offers molecular tests that help assess the risk of developing disease or disease progression and guide treatment decisions across medical specialties where molecular insights can significantly improve patient care and lower healthcare costs.

name: Nanotronics
description: An Industrial AI company that deploys advanced optical solutions to optimize manufacturing procedures, effectively refining, and expediting assembly for any industry relying on a precision process for production.

name: NeRRe Therapeutics
description: NeRRe Therapeutics is a clinical stage company developing a portfolio of neurokinin (NK) receptor antagonists for the treatment of common debilitating conditions caused by neuronal hypersensitivity. The company was formed in December 2012 and is focused on the development of a portfolio of NK receptor antagonists acquired from GlaxoSmithKline, which have therapeutic potential in a broad range of indications.

name: Neurelis, Inc.
description: A commercial-stage neuroscience company focused on the development and commercialization of therapeutics for the treatment of epilepsy and orphan neurologic disorders characterized by high unmet medical need

name: Neurogastrx
description: Neurogastrx is a biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and developing transformative therapies for gastrointestinal disorders affecting the enteric nervous system.

name: NeuroPace
description: NeuroPace is a commercial-stage medical device company that markets the Responsive Neurostimulation (RNS) System for medically refractory epilepsy with 1 or 2 epileptogenic foci. The RNS System continually monitors brainwaves for unusual activity and is able to respond instantly with corrective stimulation, thereby reducing seizure frequency; it is the first and only closed-loop responsive neurostimulation system.

name: NewMed
description: Leading transcatheter heart valve medical device company in China with broad product pipeline covering all the transcatheter procedures of mitral valve replacement, mitral valve repair, and aortic valve replacement

name: Noctrix Health
description: Noctrix Health is a pioneer in developing the next-generation of wearable therapeutics. Backed by scientific evidence and clinical data, it aims to make prescription-grade medical devices accessible so physicians and patients have more choices beyond the pill.

name: Norchem Pharma
description: Hunan Norchem Pharmaceutical is a leading steroid drug intermediates/API provider, and synthetic biology industrialization platform company in China. Over the last decade, the company gradually became one of the largest steroid intermediates providers in the world and has built a large-scale R&D and biomanufacturing platform.

name: Nucleix
description: Nucleix develops, manufactures and markets revolutionary non-invasive molecular cancer diagnostic tests. Nucleix's highly sensitive and specific tests are based on identification of subtle changes in methylation patterns.

name: Nucleus RadioPharma
description:
An innovative CDMO dedicated to the development and manufacturing
of targeted radiotherapies. With an emphasis on innovation and quality, Nucleus provides an
array of services, from formulation and analytical development to regulatory documentation and
drug product manufacturing.

name: Odyssey Therapeutics
description: Odyssey Therapeutics is a biotechnology company pioneering the efficient development of next generation immunomodulators and oncology medicines. Comprised of an expert team of drug hunters and executives, Odyssey is making a transformational impact on the field of drug discovery and is accelerating the path to clinical development to drive the creation of more effective precision medicines.

name: OnCusp Therapeutics
description: Dedicated to transforming cutting-edge preclinical innovation into clinically validated treatments for cancer patients, including CUSP06, a CDH6 ADC.

name: Ottimo Pharma
description: Ottimo Pharma is a private biotechnology company focused on the development of cancer therapies for solid tumors. The company’s lead program, Jankistomig, is a PD1-VEGFR2 bi-functional antibody designed to target both immune checkpoint inhibition and angiogenesis in a single IgG therapy.

name: PathAI
description: A leading provider of integrated AI and digital pathology solutions dedicated to transforming workflow and operational efficiency in pathology labs worldwide.

name: Pathalys Pharma
description: Committed to the development of multiple advanced therapeutics that address unmet needs in the management of end-stage kidney disease

name: Pee Safe
description: Pee Safe is a women's consumer health and wellness company offering products across the feminine hygiene and personal hygiene categories. The Company’s products are sold across online marketplaces such as Amazon, its own website, and offline channels.

name: Perfuse
description: Perfuse Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pursuing a novel mechanism to improve retinal perfusion in the context of various retinal diseases, starting with glaucoma.

name: Prelude Therapeutics
description: Prelude Therapeutics is a biotechnology company focused on discovering and developing new medicines targeting chromatin function to treat cancer.

name: ProLynx
description: Prolynx is a biotechnology company dedicated to developing ultra-long-acting medicines for obesity and related metabolic diseases.

name: ProVerum Medical
description: ProVerum is a clinical-stage medical device company developing a minimally invasive treatment for benign prostatic hyperplasia, offering patients strong symptomatic relief and a differentiated safety profile.

name: Proviva Therapeutics
description: Founded in 2019, Proviva Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of novel immuno-cytokine therapeutics for cancer. Leveraging its proprietary CROSSOVER pro-drug platform and MUSICA multifunctional effector cell activation technology, Proviva is building a globally competitive pipeline targeting major unmet needs in cancer treatment. The company’s lead program, PTX-912, a first-in-class PD-1-proIL-2 fusion protein, has already demonstrated excellent tolerability profile and promising anti-tumor activity in early stage clinical testing.

name: PULNOVO
description: A leading artery denervation platform company in China developing novel therapies in pulmonary hypertension, heart failure, and hypertension

name: Q32 Bio
description: Q32 Bio is a biotechnology company developing therapies targeting powerful regulators of the innate and adaptive immune systems, to re-balance immunity in severe autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Q32 Bio’s lead programs, focused on the IL-7R pathway and complement system, address immune dysregulation to help patients take back control of their lives.

name: QuantX Biosciences
description: QuantX is an AI-driven drug discovery company developing small molecule inhibitors of validated immunology targets relevant to a number of large market autoimmune disorders.

name: Radius Health, Inc.
description: A global biopharmaceutical company focused on addressing unmet medical needs in the areas of bone health, neuro-orphan diseases, and oncology.

name: Rampart Bioscience
description: Committed to realizing the potential of gene therapy to provide safe, long-lasting treatments for a wide range of diseases. Rampart’s versatile approach is driven by proprietary development and delivery platforms, which together create optimized therapeutics in a redosable, non-viral format.

name: RayThera
description: RayThera is a small molecule drug discovery company focused on developing safer, more effective therapies for immunological diseases.

name: ReCode Therapeutics
description: ReCode Therapeutics is an integrated genetic medicines company developing targeted, disease-modifying therapies for patients with life-limiting respiratory diseases. The Company’s diverse pipeline includes lead programs for cystic fibrosis caused by nonsense mutations, and primary ciliary dyskinesia. ReCode has developed a non-viral delivery therapeutic platform that enables it to precisely deliver its medicines safely and effectively.

name: ReLIA
description: Leading POCT company in China offering both reagents and instruments covering a broad range of cardiac and hematology tests

name: Renasant Bio
description: Renasant Bio is pioneering disease-modifying oral small molecule treatments for autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD), the leading genetic cause of end-stage renal failure. Renasant is advancing a pipeline of oral small molecule corrector and potentiator programs that target the underlying biology of ADPKD to restore the function of key proteins to halt disease progression.

name: Scribe Therapeutics
description: Scribe Therapeutics is a molecular engineering company focused on creating best-in-class in vivo therapies that permanently treat the underlying cause of disease. Scribe is overcoming the limitations of current genome editing technologies by developing custom engineered enzymes and delivery modalities as part of a proprietary, evergreen platform for CRISPR-based genetic medicine.

name: Shattuck Labs
description: Shattuck Labs is a biotechnology company specializing in the development of potential treatments for autoimmune / inflammatory diseases. The Company is developing SL-325, a potential first-in-class DR3 antagonist antibody for the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease and other inflammatory autoimmune diseases.

name: Sidewinder Therapeutics
description: Sidewinder Therapeutics is pioneering the next generation of large molecule precision therapeutics.

name: Sikka Software
description: Sikka Software develops cloud platform technologies to enhance practice economics, improve the quality of care and service experience for patients, and provide suppliers with more effective ways to reach clinicians and patients. Sikka focuses on the non-physician, non-hospital healthcare segments, which include dentistry, veterinary, audiology, optometry, and other adjacent markets, both in the US and internationally.

name: Sionna Therapeutics
description: Sionna Therapeutics is a life sciences company dedicated to developing highly effective and differentiated treatments for cystic fibrosis (CF) by normalizing the function of CFTR, the key protein associated with disease progression in CF.

name: Sirius Therapeutics
description: Sirius Therapeutics is a clinical-stage, leading developer of RNAi therapeutics for the management of chronic diseases. Sirius was founded in 2021 with a world-class leadership team and investors. Leveraging the proprietary RNAi technology, the company offers a portfolio of solutions for patients to change the future of cardiovascular disease.

name: Sitala Bio
description: Developer of anti-inflammatory medicines for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases and inflammatory diseases

name: Sneuro
description: A leading neuromodulation company providing a full solution of pain management devices and devices for other disease areas

name: Sparrow Pharmaceuticals
description: Sparrow Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel, targeted therapies for disorders of corticosteroid excess. Its lead product, SPI-62, is an oral, small molecule, novel therapeutic treatment designed to target the source of active intracellular corticosteroids in key tissues.

name: SpectronRx
description: A diagnostic and therapeutic radiopharmaceutical developer and manufacturer specializing in Radiopharmaceutical Contract Development (CDMO), Manufacturing (CMO) and Isotope Production.

name: Stairmed
description: Stairmed is the leader in developing proprietary technology platforms and products in invasive brain-computer interface (BCI). The company focuses on developing products for both neuroscience research and clinical applications targeting motor function impairments and neurodegenerative diseases.

name: Star Therapeutics
description: Biotechnology company with a mission to develop life-changing therapies for as many rare diseases as possible for the millions of patients who lack effective treatment options. Star consists of a family of companies, each focused on a specific area of biology with first-in-class therapies that each target multiple diseases.

name: Stratus Therapeutics
description: Stratus Therapeutics is developing off-the-shelf hematopoietic stem cell (HSC) therapies to treat a broad range of severe and life-threatening diseases. As the industry’s first off-the-shelf offering, Garuda’s technology has the potential to cure more than 70 diseases and eliminate dependency on donor or patient cells.

name: Suraksha Diagnostic
description: Suraksha is the leading diagnostics company in Eastern India offering pathology and radiology services. The Company has a strong brand in the region and offers a comprehensive suite of diagnostic tests. Suraksha’s central lab features Eastern India’s largest fully automated robotic track and is accredited by College of American Pathologists (CAP) and National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL).

name: TandemAI
description: TandemAI is an advanced technology company dedicated to reinventing drug discovery infrastructure. The company integrates proprietary AI-driven, high-performance computation with its efficient, large-scale in-house wet lab operations to deliver a turnkey drug discovery solution. TandemAI has built its networked platform, and is rapidly expanding the state-of-the-art high-performance computing clusters and wet labs to increase the speed of drug discovery and deliver cost-effective opportunities to its partners and to the global scientific community.

name: TELA Bio
description: TELA Bio (Nasdaq: TELA) is a commercial stage medical technology company focused on designing, developing and marketing a new category of tissue reinforcement materials to address unmet needs in soft tissue reconstruction. TELA’s products are designed to improve on shortcomings of existing biologics and minimize long-term exposure to permanent synthetic material. TELA's portfolio is supported by quality, data-driven science and extensive pre-clinical research that has consistently demonstrated advantages over other commercially available products.

name: Telios Pharma
description: Telios Pharma is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to improving the lives of patients with inflammatory diseases.

name: Tendfo

Tendfo is a clinical stage medtech company focusing on developing interventional
devices for venous thromboembolism diseases (VTE), including pulmonary
embolism (PE), deep vein thrombosis (DVT), and other diseases sharing the same
vascular path

description: The Oncology Institute, Inc. (TOI) is advancing oncology by delivering highly specialized, value-based cancer care in the community setting. TOI offers cutting-edge, evidence-based cancer care to a population of approximately 2.0 million patients including clinical trials, transfusions, and other care delivery models traditionally associated with the most advanced care delivery organizations. With over 400 employed and network clinicians and over 100 clinics and network locations of care across five states and growing, TOI is changing oncology for the better.

name: Thrombolex
